recipes.name: Swiss Grid × Bauhaus Geometry × Y2K Cyber Fashion
recipes.layout: Swiss grid for information zones; asymmetric character zone with controlled overlap.
geometry: geometric decomposition of hair locks, garment hems and shoulder lines
risks: grid and collage may conflict; separate zones
recipes.prompt: character editorial poster, Swiss grid typography, Bauhaus geometric decomposition, Y2K cyber fashion accents, asymmetric layout, restrained chrome and translucent materials, preserve original character identity

recipes.name: Art Nouveau × Art Deco × Fantasy Portrait
recipes.layout: Central portrait with organic frame and stepped geometric border.
risks: ornamental frame must not overpower face
recipes.prompt: ornate fantasy character portrait, Art Nouveau organic floral framing, Art Deco geometric symmetry, refined antique gold accents, elegant negative space, preserve character identity

recipes.name: Pop Art × Risograph × Comic Collage
recipes.layout: Comic panels or repeated subject with separate speech-bubble zone.
risks: keep eyes and facial expression free of halftone
recipes.prompt: playful character poster, Pop Art comic halftone, Risograph spot-color overprint, bold outlines, layered comic collage, expressive pose

recipes.name: Constructivism × Brutalist Graphic
recipes.layout: One dominant diagonal or radial structure; monumental typography.
recipes.prompt: constructivist graphic poster, bold diagonal composition, red black cream palette, monumental typography, brutalist editorial structure, print grain

recipes.name: Frutiger Aero × Glassmorphism
recipes.layout: Open translucent background with a few floating glass objects.
risks: preserve text contrast; avoid excessive blur
recipes.prompt: optimistic futuristic visual, Frutiger Aero aesthetic, clear blue sky and aqua green, translucent glass bubbles, water droplets, soft sunlight, clean readable composition

recipes.name: Surrealist Collage × Editorial Design
recipes.layout: Editorial grid with one surreal focal metaphor.
risks: every spatial disruption should support a concept
recipes.prompt: surrealist editorial collage, impossible scale relationships, conceptual visual metaphor, refined magazine grid, controlled negative space, tactile photographic cutouts

recipes.name: Cut-out Collage × Swiss Typography
recipes.layout: Layered character silhouette with grid-aligned title.
risks: do not damage hair, fingers or garment silhouette
recipes.prompt: layered cut-paper character collage, Swiss editorial typography, torn paper edges, precise grid, overlapping cutout shapes, preserve silhouette and facial identity
